title: SOP 205 posting — follow-up on the March 2026 commitment
summary:
On 2026-03-03 in response to W012198-022326, the Department stated: 'the Department does not currently have the associated SOPs posted on its website. We acknowledge this oversight and are actively working to ensure the SOPs are published as soon as possible.'

This request asks for the current posting URL (or confirmation that SOP 205 remains unposted), any posting records since 2026-03-03, status records on the publication work, and any related legal or compliance analysis.

policy_promises.quote: This Operating Procedure, along with SMPD Lexipol Policy 462, shall be posted conspicuously on our Department website.
policy_promises.tests: What records reflect the posting status, and what work has occurred since the 2026-03-03 commitment?

policy_promises.quote: ALPR usage and privacy policy shall be implemented, available to the public, and posted conspicuously
policy_promises.tests: How does the current practice align with the statute's conspicuous-posting requirement?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012198 surfaced the original acknowledgment that SOP 205 was not posted. This follow-up checks on the publication work.

filed_because: Following up on the publication commitment stated in W012198 — what's happened since.
notes:
Items 4–6 ask which other SOPs the Department considers subject to the same posting obligation, and whether any legal or compliance analysis has been done on the underlying question.

The records-of-publication-work item is intended to capture status updates, tickets, or internal communications about the publication effort.
